description: K-means clustering — Cluster numeric points with k-means++ (seeded, reproducible). data= points separated by ; with comma-separated coordinates (1-20 dims, max 600 points) or a plain comma list for 1-D values. Optional k= (otherwise auto-picks k=2..8 by silhouette, k=1 when there is no real structure), scale=true|false (z-score, default on for 2+ dims), labels= names separated by ;, seed=. Returns clusters with centroids in original units, sizes, spread, outliers, assignments, silhouette quality (STRONG/REASONABLE/WEAK/NO_SUBSTANTIAL_STRUCTURE) and the k-selection table. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_kmeans
